### 🟢 Approval recommended The change is narrowly scoped, correct for the documented Codex artifact behavior, and is bracketed by focused regression tests including an explicit guard against an over-broad “fix.”
Pull request overview Fixes the v3 review-route validator’s Codex evidence collection so that Codex’s long-lived, in-place–edited summary comment no longer outranks the immutable clean verdict comment, unblocking the default hosted lane on schema v3 PRs. **Changes:** - Update `_bot_activity()` to key Codex *comment* signals on `createdAt` (not `max(createdAt, updatedAt)`) for schema v3. - Add regression tests covering (1) summary edited after verdict, (2) summary created before head but edited after, and (3) a guard test ensuring a *newly created* post-verdict Codex comment still invalidates an older clean verdict.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | scripts/validate_review_route.py | Adjusts schema v3 Codex comment signal ordering to prevent in-place edits of a persistent summary comment from defeating clean verdict evidence. | | tests/backend/test_review_route_policy.py | Adds targeted tests that reproduce the live failure mode and assert the fix doesn’t weaken the “newer created artifact supersedes older verdict” rule. |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 2/2 changed files - **Comments generated:** 0 - **Review effort level:** Lite
